# Falcon Games Unlocks Premium Demand Beyond Gaming with Magnite DV+


Magnite Team


November 18, 2026 | 1 min read


Discover how Falcon Games partnered with Magnite DV+ to unlock premium brand demand beyond traditional gaming advertisers. Through a direct OpenRTB integration, Falcon Games expanded access to global brand budgets, strengthened buyer engagement, and improved monetization performance, achieving 18X growth in advertiser spend and up to 84% eCPM uplift across previously under-monetized game titles.
